source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 23 (PDF 208-214), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 23 (Pharmacology) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The branch of biology that deals with the study of drugs and their effects on living organisms is:
(Biology ki woh shakh jo dawaon aur zinda organisms par un ke asraat ka mutaala karti hai:)
blocks.explanation: Pharmacology dawaon aur zinda organisms par un ke asraat ka mutaala hai, jis mein un ke zariye, khasiyat, banawat, ilaji istemal aur jism par asar shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Pharmacology is the branch of biology that deals with the study of drugs

blocks.prompt:
2 Drugs are chemical substances used to:
(Drugs (adwiyat) woh kimiyai mawad hain jo kis liye istemal hote hain?)

options.text: bimariyon ki tashkhees, bachao ya ilaj
sirf tajarbe mein bimari paida karna

blocks.explanation: Drugs woh kimiyai mawad hain jo bimariyon ki tashkhees, bachao ya ilaj ke liye istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Drugs are chemical substances used to diagnose, prevent, or treat diseases

blocks.prompt:
3 Drugs may be obtained from:
(Drugs kahan se hasil ki ja sakti hain?)

options.text: paude, janwar, microorganisms ya laboratory mein tayyari

blocks.explanation: Drugs qudrati zariyon (paudon, janwaron, microorganisms) se ya laboratory mein bana kar hasil hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Drugs may be obtained from natural sources such as plants, animals, and microorganisms

blocks.prompt:
4 Medicines prepared from plants and used in traditional systems of treatment are known as:
(Paudon se bani dawaiyan jo riwayati tareeqa-e-ilaj mein istemal hoti hain, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paudon se bani dawaiyan riwayati ilaj mein aam hain aur herbal medicines ya phytotherapy kehlati hain.

book_ref.quote: are known as herbal medicines or Phytotherapy

blocks.prompt:
5 Before a drug is approved for public use, its testing evaluates its:
(Kisi dawa ko awam ke liye manzoori se pehle testing mein kya parkha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Manzoori se pehle dawa kayi marahil ki testing se guzarti hai jis mein us ki hifazat (safety), asar (efficacy) aur meyar (quality) parkhe jate hain.

book_ref.quote: it undergoes several stages of testing to evaluate its safety, efficacy, and quality

blocks.prompt:
6 Drug discovery is:
(Drug discovery kya hai?)

options.text: kisi bimari ke liye nayi dawa dhoondne ka ibtidai marhala
dawa ki bare paimane par tayyari
market mein aayi dawa ki nigrani

blocks.explanation: Drug discovery kisi bimari ke liye nayi dawa dhoondne ka ibtidai marhala hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the initial stage of finding a new drug for any disease

blocks.prompt:
7 In drug discovery, a "target" is:
(Drug discovery mein "target" kya hai?)

options.text: koi khaas molecule, maslan protein ya enzyme, jo bimari paida karne mein shamil ho

blocks.explanation: Scientists aik khaas molecule, maslan protein ya enzyme, pehchante hain jo bimari paida karne mein shamil ho aur jis par dawa asar kar sake.

book_ref.quote: such as a protein or enzyme, that is involved in causing a disease

blocks.prompt:
8 In target validation, researchers:
(Target validation mein researchers kya karte hain?)

options.text: tasdeeq karte hain ke target bimari mein ahem hai aur us par asar se ilaji faida hota hai
lead compounds ko zehreelapan kam karne ke liye badalna

blocks.explanation: Target validation mein tasdeeq ki jati hai ke target bimari mein ahem kirdar rakhta hai; tajarbon se yaqeeni banaya jata hai ke us par asar karne se ilaji faida hoga.

book_ref.quote: Researchers confirm that the identified target plays an important role in the disease process

blocks.prompt:
9 Promising substances found by screening thousands of natural or synthetic compounds against the target are called:
(Target ke khilaf hazaron qudrati ya masnooi compounds ki screening se milne wale umeed afza mawad kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Scientists hazaron qudrati ya masnooi compounds parakh kar woh mawad dhoondte hain jo target se achhi tarah amal karen; yeh lead compounds hain.

book_ref.quote: These promising substances are called lead compounds

blocks.prompt:
10 In lead optimization, lead compounds are modified to:
(Lead optimization mein lead compounds ko kis liye badla jata hai?)

options.text: asar barhana, zehreelapan kam karna aur dawa jaisi khasiyat behtar karna

blocks.explanation: Lead compounds ko asar barhane, zehreelapan kam karne aur dawa jaisi khasiyat behtar karne ke liye badla jata hai.

book_ref.quote: These lead compounds are modified to improve their effectiveness, reduce toxicity

blocks.prompt:
11 Which is the correct order of the stages of drug discovery?
(Drug discovery ke marahil ki sahi tarteeb kaun si hai?)

options.text: Lead optimization, target identification, target validation, lead compound identification
Target validation, target identification, lead optimization, lead compound identification
Lead compound identification, lead optimization, target identification, target validation
Target identification, target validation, lead compound identification, lead optimization

blocks.explanation: Drug discovery target identification se target validation, phir lead compound identification aur aakhir mein lead optimization tak jati hai.

book_ref.quote: There are following stages in the discovery of modern drugs

blocks.prompt:
12 Drug development is the process of:
(Drug development kis amal ko kehte hain?)

options.text: bimari paida karne wale targets pehchanna
daryaft shuda dawa ko test kar ke awam ke liye tayyar karna

blocks.explanation: Drug development daryaft shuda dawa ko test kar ke awam ke istemal ke liye tayyar karne ka amal hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the process of testing and preparing the discovered drug for public use

blocks.prompt:
13 In preclinical research, "in vivo" testing means testing:
(Preclinical research mein "in vivo" testing ka matlab hai testing:)
blocks.explanation: Preclinical marhale mein compounds in vitro (cells ki culture) aur in vivo (janwaron) mein safety, toxicity aur efficacy ke liye test hote hain, insani trials se pehle.

book_ref.quote: Compounds are tested in vitro (cell-based culture) and in vivo (animal)

blocks.prompt:
14 Phase 1 of clinical trials tests a drug on:
(Clinical trials ke Phase 1 mein dawa kis par test hoti hai?)

options.text: 1,000-3,000 mareez, efficacy ki tasdeeq ke liye
sehatmand razakaron ka chhota group (20-100), safety aur dose ke liye
cell cultures, target dhoondne ke liye

blocks.explanation: Phase 1 mein dawa sehatmand razakaron ke chhote group (20-100) par safety aur dose maloom karne ke liye test hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: of healthy volunteers are taken to determine safety and dosage

blocks.prompt:
15 Large-scale trials of 1,000-3,000 patients to confirm efficacy and monitor adverse reactions form:
(1,000-3,000 mareezon par bare paimane ke trials jo efficacy ki tasdeeq aur muzir asraat ki nigrani karte hain, kaun sa phase hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phase 3 bare paimane ke trials (1,000-3,000) hain jo mareezon mein efficacy ki tasdeeq aur muzir asraat ki nigrani karte hain.

book_ref.quote: are taken to confirm the efficacy and monitor their adverse reactions in patients

blocks.prompt:
16 After clinical trials, all the data are examined to approve or reject the drug by:
(Clinical trials ke baad dawa ki manzoori ya rad ke liye saara data kaun jaanchta hai?)

options.text: regulatory idare jaise FDA ya EMA

blocks.explanation: FDA drug review mein regulatory idare (FDA ya EMA) saara clinical data jaanch kar dawa ko market se pehle manzoor ya rad karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Regulatory agencies (FDA or EMA) thoroughly examine all data

blocks.prompt:
17 Once a drug is approved, the next stage is:
(Dawa manzoor hone ke baad agla marhala kya hai?)

options.text: bare paimane par tayyari aur marketing

blocks.explanation: Manzoori ke baad dawa pharmaceutical industries mein bare paimane par banai jati hai aur ilaj ke liye muhayya ki jati hai.

book_ref.quote: the drug is produced on a large scale in pharmaceutical industries

blocks.prompt:
18 Post-marketing surveillance of a drug means:
(Dawa ki post-marketing surveillance se kya murad hai?)

options.text: insani trials se pehle janwaron par testing
target ke khilaf compounds ki screening
market mein aane ke baad lambe arse aur kam paye jane wale side effects ki musalsal nigrani

blocks.explanation: Market mein aane ke baad bhi dawa ki lambe arse ke asraat aur kam honay wale side effects ke liye musalsal nigrani hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: the drug is continuously monitored for long-term effects and rare side effects

blocks.prompt:
19 Antibiotics are drugs that treat bacterial infections by:
(Antibiotics bacterial infections ka ilaj kaise karti hain?)

options.text: bacteria ko maar kar ya un ki barhotri rok kar
cells ke andar viruses ko maar kar
sirf immune system ko taqat de kar

blocks.explanation: Antibiotics bacteria ko maar kar ya un ki barhotri rok kar bacterial infection ka ilaj karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Antibiotics are drugs that treat bacterial infection by killing bacteria or stopping their growth

blocks.prompt:
20 Antibiotics are classified primarily on the basis of their:
(Antibiotics ki darja bandi bunyadi tor par kis buniyad par hoti hai?)

options.text: amal ka tareeqa aur kimiyai banawat

blocks.explanation: Antibiotics ki darja bandi un ke amal ke tareeqe aur kimiyai banawat par hoti hai; chaar bari qismein penicillin, tetracycline, fluoroquinolones aur sulfonamides hain.

book_ref.quote: Antibiotics are classified primarily by their mechanism of action and chemical structure

blocks.prompt:
21 Penicillin antibiotics are derived from:
(Penicillin antibiotics kahan se hasil hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin bactericidal antibiotics ka group hai jo Penicillium fungi se hasil hota hai.

book_ref.quote: antibiotics derived from Penicillium fungi

blocks.prompt:
22 Penicillin was discovered in 1928 by:
(Penicillin 1928 mein kis ne daryaft ki?)
blocks.explanation: Alexander Fleming ne 1928 mein penicillin daryaft ki.

book_ref.quote: Alexander Fleming (1928), discover it

blocks.prompt:
23 Penicillin stops new bacterial cell wall synthesis by interrupting the:
(Penicillin bacteria ki nayi cell wall banna kis cheez ko rok kar band karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin peptidoglycan (murein) chains ki cross-linking rok kar nayi cell wall banne ko band karti hai (book correction: is ka target cell wall hai, cell membrane nahin).

book_ref.quote: It interrupt the cross-linking of peptidoglycan (murein) chains

blocks.prompt:
24 Penicillin targets bacteria and not animal cells because animal cells:
(Penicillin bacteria ko nishana banati hai, janwaron ke cells ko nahin, kyun ke janwaron ke cells mein:)
blocks.explanation: Janwaron ke cells mein cell wall nahin hoti jise penicillin nishana banati hai, is liye yeh bacteria par asar karti hai.

book_ref.quote: animal cells lack the cell walls that are targeted by the drug

blocks.prompt:
25 After the attack of penicillin, a bacterial cell may:
(Penicillin ke hamle ke baad bacterial cell ke saath kya ho sakta hai?)

options.text: sirf barhna band kar ke zinda rehta hai
phat sakta hai (lysis) kyun ke wall ki mazbooti khatam ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: Cell wall apni mazbooti barqarar nahin rakh sakti aur cell phat sakta hai (lysis); penicillin sirf barhotri nahin rokti balke maar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: it may burst (lysis), after the attack of penicillin

blocks.prompt:
26 Some bacteria resist penicillin by producing enzymes called:
(Kuch bacteria penicillin ka muqabla kin enzymes ko bana kar karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Muzahmat (resistance) ke liye kuch bacteria beta-lactamases jaise khaas enzymes banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Some bacteria defend themselves by producing specific enzymes like beta-lactamases

blocks.prompt:
27 Tetracycline enters bacterial cells and reversibly binds to the:
(Tetracycline bacterial cells mein dakhil ho kar kis se reversibly jurti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tetracycline target cell ki 30S ribosomal subunit se reversibly jurti hai.

book_ref.quote: reversibly bind to the 30S ribosomal subunit of its target cell

blocks.prompt:
28 By binding the 30S ribosome, tetracyclines inhibit protein synthesis because they:
(30S ribosome se jur kar tetracyclines protein banna kaise rokti hain?)

options.text: folic acid ki tayyari rokti hai
aminoacyl-tRNA ko acceptor site se jurne nahin deti

blocks.explanation: 30S ribosome se jur kar tetracyclines aminoacyl-tRNA ko acceptor site se jurne nahin deti, is tarah translation aur protein banna ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: they prevent aminoacyl-t RNA from binding to the acceptor site

blocks.prompt:
29 Tetracycline is an oral antibiotic used to treat infections such as:
(Tetracycline munh se li jane wali antibiotic hai jo kin infections ka ilaj karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tetracycline bacteriostatic oral antibiotic hai jo chlamydia aur syphilis jaise bacterial infections mein di jati hai.

book_ref.quote: used to treat bacterial infections like chlamydia and syphilis

blocks.prompt:
30 Tetracycline should not be taken with:
(Tetracycline kis ke saath nahin leni chahiye?)

options.text: doodh ki cheezein ya iron supplements

blocks.explanation: Tetracycline doodh ki cheezon ya iron supplements ke saath nahin leni chahiye.

book_ref.quote: It should not be taken with dairy or iron supplements

blocks.prompt:
31 A common side effect of tetracycline, besides nausea, vomiting and diarrhea, is:
(Matli, ulti aur dast ke ilawa tetracycline ka aam side effect kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tetracycline ke aam side effects mein matli, ulti, dast aur dhoop se hassasiyat shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Common side effects include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and sun sensitivity

blocks.prompt:
32 Tetracyclines are bacteriostatic. This means they:
(Tetracyclines bacteriostatic hain. Is ka matlab hai woh:)

options.text: bacteria ko phaar kar maarti hain
bacteria ko maare baghair un ka barhna aur taadad barhana rokti hain
cells ke andar viruses ko maarti hain
sirf Gram-negative bacteria par kaam karti hain

blocks.explanation: Bacteriostatic dawa bacteria ko maarti nahin balke un ka barhna aur taadad barhana rokti hai; tetracyclines Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono par asar karti hain.

book_ref.quote: They stop bacteria from growing and multiplying rather than killing them outright

blocks.prompt:
33 Fluoroquinolones are synthetic antibacterial agents derived as a byproduct of the synthesis of:
(Fluoroquinolones masnooi antibacterial mawad hain jo kis ki tayyari ke zimni paidawar (byproduct) ke tor par mile?)
blocks.explanation: Fluoroquinolones masnooi antibacterial mawad hain jo chloroquine (quinine) ki tayyari ke byproduct ke tor par hasil hue.

book_ref.quote: derived as a byproduct of chloroquine (quinine) synthesis

blocks.prompt:
34 Quinine, from which chloroquine is derived, is a natural alkaloid found in the:
(Quinine, jis se chloroquine banti hai, aik qudrati alkaloid hai jo kahan milta hai?)

options.text: South American Cinchona darakht ki chhaal
Streptomyces genus ke mitti ke bacteria
Asia ke herbal paudon ke patte

blocks.explanation: Chloroquine quinine ki banawat badal kar bani masnooi dawa hai; quinine South American Cinchona darakht ki chhaal mein paya jane wala qudrati alkaloid hai.

book_ref.quote: a natural alkaloid found in the bark of the South American Cinchona tree

blocks.prompt:
35 Fluoroquinolones act by inhibiting bacterial:
(Fluoroquinolones bacteria ki kis cheez ko rok kar asar karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fluoroquinolones bacterial cells mein ja kar un ke Type II topoisomerases (DNA gyrase aur topoisomerase IV) ko rokti hain.

book_ref.quote: Fluoroquinolones enter the bacterial cells and inhibit their Type II topoisomerases

blocks.prompt:
36 In Gram-negative bacteria, fluoroquinolones primarily target:
(Gram-negative bacteria mein fluoroquinolones bunyadi tor par kis ko nishana banati hain?)

options.text: topoisomerase IV, replicate DNA ka alag hona rok kar
DNA gyrase, replication mein DNA ka khulna rok kar

blocks.explanation: Gram-negative mein bunyadi nishana DNA gyrase hai (DNA ka khulna rokta hai); Gram-positive mein topoisomerase IV (replicate hui DNA ka alag hona rokta hai).

book_ref.quote: Primarily targeted in Gram-negative bacteria

blocks.prompt:
37 Fluoroquinolones are bactericidal because they:
(Fluoroquinolones bactericidal kyun hain?)

options.text: sirf kuch der barhotri rokti hain
khurak se folic acid jazb hona rokti hain
replication ke enzymes ko phansa kar complex banati hain jis se DNA ki dono strands toot jati hain

blocks.explanation: Yeh DNA replication ke enzymes ko phansa kar aisa complex banati hain jis se DNA ki dono strands toot jati hain; bacteria barh nahin pate aur mar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: creating a complex that causes double-strand DNA breaks

blocks.prompt:
38 A rare but significant adverse side effect associated with fluoroquinolones is:
(Fluoroquinolones ka kam magar sangeen side effect kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fluoroquinolones ke kam magar sangeen asraat: tendon phatna, peripheral neuropathy, drug resistance aur dil ke masail.

book_ref.quote: including tendon ruptures, peripheral neuropathy

blocks.prompt:
39 Which pair of antibiotics is classified as bactericidal?
(Antibiotics ka kaun sa jora bactericidal (bacteria maarne wala) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin (cell phatna) aur fluoroquinolones (DNA tootna) bacteria ko maarti hain; tetracycline aur akeli sulfonamides bacteriostatic hain.

book_ref.quote: so it classified as bactericidal (kills bacteria)

blocks.prompt:
40 Sulfonamides were discovered in 1932 by:
(Sulfonamides 1932 mein kis ne daryaft kiye?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfonamides, jo sulfanilamide se bane masnooi compounds hain, Gerhard Domagk ne 1932 mein daryaft kiye.

book_ref.quote: discovered by Gerhard Domagk in 1932

blocks.prompt:
41 Sulfonamides inhibit bacterial synthesis of:
(Sulfonamides bacteria mein kis cheez ki tayyari rokti hain?)

options.text: folic acid, jo DNA aur barhotri ke liye zaroori hai

blocks.explanation: Sulfonamides competitive inhibitors ke tor par bacteria mein folic acid ki tayyari rokti hain, jo DNA banne aur barhotri ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: inhibit bacterial synthesis of folic acid, which is essential for DNA synthesis

blocks.prompt:
42 Sulfonamides are selectively toxic to bacteria and not to human cells because:
(Sulfonamides sirf bacteria ke liye zehreeli hain, insani cells ke liye nahin, kyun ke:)

options.text: insani cells mein cell wall hoti hai
insaan folate khud shuru se banate hain
bacteria ko folate khud banana parta hai jab ke insaan use khurak se lete hain

blocks.explanation: Bacteria ko folate khud banana parta hai jab ke insaan use khurak se jazb karte hain, is liye dawa bacteria ko zaroori ghiza se mehroom karti hai aur insani cells mehfooz rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Bacteria must build this essential vitamin from scratch

blocks.prompt:
43 Sulfonamides are often combined with trimethoprim to:
(Sulfonamides ko aksar trimethoprim ke saath kyun milaya jata hai?)

options.text: zyada mazboot bactericidal asar ke liye
sirf Gram-positive tak mehdood karne ke liye
unhein monoclonal antibodies banane ke liye

blocks.explanation: Trimethoprim jaise mawad ke saath mil kar sulfonamides ka bactericidal (maarne wala) asar zyada mazboot hota hai.

book_ref.quote: They are often combined with other agents, like trimethoprim

blocks.prompt:
44 Being broad spectrum, sulfonamides are often used for:
(Broad spectrum hone ki wajah se sulfonamides aksar kin bimariyon mein istemal hoti hain?)

options.text: peshab ki naali ke infections, acne aur saans ke infections

blocks.explanation: Sulfonamides Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono par asar karti hain aur aksar peshab ki naali ke infections, acne aur saans ke infections mein di jati hain.

book_ref.quote: often used for urinary tract infections, acne, and respiratory infections

blocks.prompt:
45 Which is a side effect of sulfonamides?
(Sulfonamides ka side effect kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfonamides aam tor par munh se di jati hain aur in ke kuch side effects hain: jild par daane, matli, roshni se hassasiyat aur gurde ka nuqsan.

book_ref.quote: rashes, nausea, photosensitivity and kidney damage

blocks.prompt:
46 Antiviral drugs can combat a wide range of viruses, including:
(Antiviral dawaiyan kin viruses ke khilaf kaam kar sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Antiviral dawaiyan jism mein viruses ka barhna aur taadad barhana rokti hain aur hepatitis, influenza aur herpes viruses ke khilaf kaam karti hain.

book_ref.quote: including the hepatitis, influenza, and herpes viruses

blocks.prompt:
47 Retroviruses are viruses that replicate using:
(Retroviruses kis ki madad se apni copies banate hain?)

options.text: DNA gyrase, DNA genetic material ke saath
beta-lactamase, protein genetic material ke saath
enzyme reverse transcriptase, RNA genetic material ke saath

blocks.explanation: Retroviruses, jaise HIV, enzyme reverse transcriptase se copies banate hain aur un ka genetic material RNA hai.

book_ref.quote: Retroviruses are viruses that replicate by using enzyme reverse transcriptase

blocks.prompt:
48 Which statement about antiviral and antiretroviral drugs is correct?
(Antiviral aur antiretroviral dawaon ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Tamam antiretroviral dawaiyan antiviral hain, magar tamam antiviral antiretroviral nahin
Antiretroviral dawaiyan bacterial infections ka ilaj karti hain
Antiviral dawaiyan sirf retroviruses par asar karti hain

blocks.explanation: Antiretroviral dawaiyan HIV jaise retroviruses ka ilaj karti hain, is liye yeh antiviral ki aik qisam hain; antiviral dawaiyan doosre viruses ka bhi ilaj karti hain.

book_ref.quote: All Antiretroviral are Antiviral but all Antiviral are not Antiretroviral

blocks.prompt:
49 Monoclonal antibodies are:
(Monoclonal antibodies kya hain?)

options.text: laboratory mein bane molecules jo immune system ki pathogens se larne ki salahiyat barhate hain
mitti ke bacteria ki qudrati antibiotics
phytotherapy mein istemal hone wale paudon ke ajza

blocks.explanation: Monoclonal antibodies laboratory mein banaye gaye molecules hain jo khaas antigens ko nishana bana kar immune system ki pathogens se larne ki salahiyat barhate hain.

book_ref.quote: These are artificially laboratory-produced molecules

blocks.prompt:
50 Because they target specific antigens, monoclonal antibodies are effective for treating:
(Khaas antigens ko nishana banane ki wajah se monoclonal antibodies kin bimariyon ke ilaj mein mufeed hain?)

options.text: cancer, autoimmune bimariyan aur infectious bimariyan

blocks.explanation: Monoclonal antibodies khaas antigens ko nishana banati hain, is liye cancer, autoimmune bimariyon aur infectious bimariyon mein mufeed hain.

book_ref.quote: making them effective for treating cancer, autoimmune disorders, and infectious diseases

blocks.prompt:
51 Monoclonal antibodies are integral to personalized medicine because they:
(Monoclonal antibodies personalized medicine ka lazmi hissa kyun hain?)

options.text: har mareez aur bimari ke liye aik jaisi hain
sirf herbal dawa ke tor par li jati hain
tamam vaccines ki jagah le leti hain
har mareez ke profile ke mutabiq ilaj mumkin banati hain

blocks.explanation: Monoclonal antibodies har mareez ke profile ke mutabiq ilaj mumkin banati hain, jo har mareez ki apni biology ke liye munasib ho.

book_ref.quote: Monoclonal antibodies are integral to personalized medicine

blocks.prompt:
52 Technologies that allow the simultaneous testing of thousands of potential antibodies help by:
(Hazaron mumkina antibodies ko aik saath test karne wali technologies kaise madad deti hain?)

options.text: antibodies ke side effects barhati hain
tayyari ka waqt kam kar ke infectious bimariyon aur cancer ka jald jawab mumkin banati hain
antibodies ko kam khaas banati hain
testing ki zaroorat khatam karti hain

blocks.explanation: Yeh technologies hazaron antibodies aik saath test karti hain, tayyari ka waqt kam karti hain aur infectious bimariyon aur cancer jaise fori masail ka jald jawab deti hain.

book_ref.quote: enable the simultaneous testing of thousands of potential antibodies

blocks.prompt:
53 As compared to traditional drugs, monoclonal antibodies offer:
(Riwayati dawaon ke muqable mein monoclonal antibodies kya faida deti hain?)

options.text: zyada zehreelapan aur thori der ke asraat
kam zehreelapan aur der tak rehne wale asraat ka imkan

blocks.explanation: Riwayati dawaon ke muqable mein monoclonal antibodies kam zehreeli hain aur in ke asraat der tak reh sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: they offer lower toxicity, potential for long-lasting effects
